_note:
D-A-FRESH-BOOK-CANNOT-GET-ITS-FIRST-GLOSSARY-ENTITY-THROUGH-CHAT — the reproduction the row was filed without. The chain is recorded in the glossary_propose_entities TOOL note, measured live on book 019ffa27, but it never had a defect row and so was never re-run.

THE FIXTURE IS DELIBERATELY UNSEEDED. Every other glossary scenario in this repo seeds `adopt` over REST first, precisely because chat cannot reach it — which is corroboration for the defect and also why no existing scenario can see it. This one seeds NOTHING, which is the whole point: a brand-new book is exactly the condition.

WHAT A PASS AND A FAIL LOOK LIKE ARE BOTH INFORMATIVE. If the turn creates the entity, the wall is gone and the row is withdrawn. If it is refused, the row is reproduced — and the interesting half is WHICH tools the turn withheld, because the recorded chain is that the refusal's own remedy was withheld in the same turn.

scenarios.prompt: Add a character named Aldric Vane to this book's glossary.
scenarios.prompt_source: The plainest possible statement of the recorded chain's first step: a new book, an author asking for one character. The tool note's measured failure mode is 'character is not in this book's vocabulary. This book has: (none yet).'

seed_assert.query: SELECT count(*)::text FROM glossary_entities WHERE book_id='{book_id}'
seed_assert.why: A fresh book, and nothing seeded — this asserts the fixture really is the empty condition the defect needs rather than a book that quietly inherited an ontology.

scenarios.falsifier:
REPRODUCED IF: the turn does not create an entity on this book AND the refusal is about the kind not being in the book's vocabulary.

WITHDRAWN IF: the entity is created. That would mean some path now reaches the ontology from chat and the row is wrong.

🔴 THE HALF THAT MATTERS FOR THE FIX is not the refusal but the WITHHELD SET: the recorded chain is that the refusal named glossary_adopt_standards while that same turn withheld it at stage=intent_gate. A run where the remedy was ADVERTISED and simply not called is a different finding (selection, not reach) and must not be read as this defect.

ship_audit.gate: EXERCISED — approve is set so a card cannot be mistaken for the wall.
ship_audit.idempotency: N/A — nothing is expected to be created.
